stele.t: Merneptah Stele ('Israel Stele'). Egyptian Museum, Cairo, JE 31408 / CG 34025. Granite; found by W. M. F. Petrie in 1896 in Merneptah's mortuary temple, western Thebes. Year 5 of Merneptah.

lichtheim1976.t: Lichtheim, M. (1976). Ancient Egyptian Literature, Vol. II: The New Kingdom. Berkeley: University of California Press. bible.t: Hebrew Bible (Tanakh), cited by book and verse in each line. Religious tradition, written down centuries after the events it tells.

ne.t: Natural Earth (public domain): coastlines, rivers, lakes.
